warning.titlePre: Land Rover Freelander 1.8i Head Gasket Failure
paragraphs: If your Freelander 1.8i has the Rover K-Series engine — that's the L314 generation, produced from 1997 to 2006 — head gasket failure is a well-documented pattern on this engine, backed by multiple manufacturer technical service bulletins and specialist sources. We replace the head gasket, water pump and timing belt as standard on every Freelander 1.8i rebuild.
